test_title: PYST 37: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 4 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘MINUTE’ is written as ‘NKOWUG’ and ‘LESSON’ is written as ‘MGTUPP’. How will ‘IMPORT’ be written in that language?
solution:
The alphabets and their positions will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63298a47acd53b254b8ad8e2dd6978d33df89ad763097e5b89c5add127273f64.png] 

The logic here is:

For the word ‘MINUTE’ is written as ‘NKOWUG’ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41d03ed22838fa31b6cf98da2bb727dd66b98dec712706627f9c0ef4a9147ce9.png] 

Also, for the word ‘LESSON’ is written as ‘MGTUPP’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8db1faf655ac0c7543204ab44f46de9a485caec9fc3c93984670b0bef1140b97.png] 

Similarly, for the word IMPORT is written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b4befbcabb8e40ccb26e9063aa7544332330245ef4cee18b23399a823b95230.png] 

Thus, the code language is '**JOQQSV**'.

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 4**__'.
